run_mcp_math_server: run the MCP math tools server using python math_server.py to expose math operations
add_two_numbers: call the add tool to add two float numbers together and return the sum
subtract_two_numbers: call the subtract tool to subtract b from a and return the result
multiply_two_numbers: call the multiply tool to multiply two float numbers and return the product
calculate_square_root: call the square_root tool to calculate the square root of a non-negative number
